name: Desires & Power: A Dark World
source:
Enter a dark and dangerous world where power is everything and nothing is as it seems. The mysterious MC arrives in a new city to study? at a renowned university. A world where ruthless criminal organizations and powerful families are engaged in a deadly battle for ultimate control. And as if that wasn't enough, the MC harbors secrets of his own, ones that could tip the balance of power and change the course of the game. Are you ready to unravel the twists and turns of a world where anything can happen and no one can be trusted? With the option to have one, or all, of the women, prepare for a thrilling journey filled with suspense, intrigue, and romance in this adult visual novel.

[From [URL=https://www.patreon.com/DarkFireVNs]Patreon[/URL]]
translation:
进入一个黑暗而危险的世界，权力就是一切，一切都不像表面上看起来的那样。神秘MC来到新城市求学？在一所著名大学。在这个世界里，残酷的犯罪组织和强大的家族为了最终的控制权而展开殊死的战斗。似乎这还不够，MC还隐藏着自己的秘密，这些秘密可能会打破权力平衡并改变游戏进程。你准备好揭开这个一切皆有可能发生、无人可信任的世界的曲折了吗？在这部成人视觉小说中，可以选择与一名或全部女性一起，准备踏上充满悬念、阴谋和浪漫的惊心动魄的旅程。

[来自 [URL=https://www.patreon.com/DarkFireVNs]Patreon[/URL]]
